forms_signatures.text: All training and instructional support services must be performed in accordance with FAA Order JO 3120.4S, Air Traffic Technical Training, and in accordance with other applicable FAA Orders, Directives, and Standards referenced in Section C.2.1. The Contractor must provide qualified instructors and training program support service staff to conduct and administer all tasks required under this SOW. All instructors and training support services staff must meet the minimum personnel qualifications listed in Attachment J-2 for the applicable labor category and must obtain the appropriate FAA certifications in accordance with Attachment J-2 Appendix A, Contractor Certification Requirements. The FAA Academy and field facilities have different training needs based on the type of training performed at each location. The FAA Academy provides more generalized initial ATC training as a foundation to newly hired or newly placed developmentals to prepare them for field training. ATC Facilities require location-specific training to certify air traffic specialists at each individual site. The Contractor must support all designated FAA training courses, including specialized staff training courses as identified by the COR. The Contractor must transition to new training materials and
